verdict.rationale: BILL documents a broad REST v3 API (full verbs) whose S&E surface covers budgets, users, virtual cards, transactions and reimbursements, alongside webhooks for S&E events and a recipe for S&E expense management, so much of the core S&E workflow is scriptable. Nothing in the docs claims the API matches what the UI can do: 'full breadth' refers to the API platform, not UI parity, and several UI-marketed features (custom approval policies, AI-powered categorization, purchase requests) are not shown as available through the S&E API. Missing for 10: an explicit UI-parity statement or coverage matrix, API evidence for S&E approval policies, AI categorization and purchase-request workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration of parity.
